name: PEA
summary: France's equity savings plan. Invest in European shares; after 5 years, gains are only subject to social charges.

rules.name: Client is a French tax resident
rules.message: A PEA can only be held by a French tax resident. Client residency: {tax_residency}.
rules.explain: The PEA is a French tax regime. Only French tax residents can open or fund one.

rules.name: One PEA per taxpayer
rules.message: This client already holds a PEA ({existing}).
rules.explain: Each taxpayer may hold a single PEA across all providers.

rules.name: Lifetime contribution limit
rules.message: This deposit exceeds the PEA contribution limit.
rules.explain: Total payments into a PEA are capped at €150,000 over the life of the plan.

rules.name: Instrument is PEA-eligible
rules.explain: PEA requires eligible EU/EEA exposure: shares of companies headquartered in the EU/EEA, or funds holding at least 75% EU/EEA equities.

rules.name: Sufficient cash in the plan
rules.message: Not enough cash in the plan. Required {required}, available {available}.
rules.explain: Purchases and withdrawals must be covered by cash held inside the wrapper.

rules.name: 5-year holding period
rules.message: The plan is {plan_age} years old. A withdrawal before year 5 closes the PEA.
rules.explain: Withdrawing before the 5th anniversary closes the plan and gains are taxed at the full rate.

schedule.label: Before 5 years
schedule.note: 12.8% income tax + 18.6% social charges on the gain portion. The withdrawal closes the PEA.

schedule.label: After 5 years
schedule.note: Income-tax exempt. Only 18.6% social charges on the gain portion. The plan stays open.
